Parent Epic: #44
Depends on: #45 dossier compiler, #46 closure monitor, #47 execution DAG and Evidence Plane #50/#51.
Source: attached `現代網頁設計架構擴充建議.pdf`.

## Goal
Run the first complete reverse-engineering pipeline on three materially different product archetypes from the source PDF while preserving all proposed internal technologies as hypotheses until independently observed.

## Canary set
1. **Flair AI archetype** — spatial constraint, multi-pass rendering, diffusion/inpainting and visual closure.
2. **Creatify archetype** — URL intake, asset tokenization, storyboard AST, constraint solving and deterministic rendering.
3. **AST interaction archetype** — Magic Patterns or Arcade: local AST/DOM patching, stateful interaction and bidirectional editing.

The exact third subject must be frozen before execution; do not combine two products into one count.

## Required per-product artifacts
```text
source signal packet
dossier.json / dossier.md
user-problem-workflow map
product State Machine
capability and rights graph
problem-closure matrix
MVP boundary and stop-loss
execution DAG and prompt packets
issue/Stack proposal
explicit non-claims
```

## Source treatment
- PDF statements about YC product internals are `SOURCE_STATEMENT` or `HYPOTHESIS`, not observed architecture.
- Code blocks are proposed implementations, not proof of the named product's codebase.
- performance, cost, license and quality numbers remain unverified until separately bound.
- page diagrams/tables and code must retain page/line/visual locators.

## Controls
- internal library mapping promoted to fact;
- three canaries sharing one untracked source signal;
- PDF popularity/YC status treated as demand;
- beautiful output treated as workflow/user value;
- proposed package license treated as complete transitive-rights proof;
- technical closure promoted to paid validation;
- missing source visual/table evidence silently ignored.

## Acceptance
- all three runs consume pinned source/evidence packets;
- outputs are deterministic where contracts require it;
- each canary has different user/problem/mechanism and falsifier surfaces;
- every unsupported product-internal statement remains hypothesis/unknown;
- closure monitor reports exact missing technical, live, user and commercial lanes;
- no canary enters `BUILD` without existing buyer/adoption gates;
- the resulting gaps can be compiled into non-overlapping Molecular Stack issues.

## Evidence boundary
The canaries validate the reverse-engineering process against this source. They do not establish the real internal architecture, performance, licensing, market demand or product quality of the named companies.
